title: PAY-1432: Add preferred contact time to Case 360
body:
## Summary
Adds the Preferred contact time field to the Case 360 contact section via JSON config.

## Acceptance criteria → evidence
| AC | Test(s) | Status |
|----|---------|--------|
| 1 | caseContact.test.js › shows field after Phone | ✅ |
| 2 | caseContact.test.js › shows Not provided when empty | ✅ |
| 3 | caseContact.test.js › hides field without access | ✅ |

## Pattern followed
configs/case360.json → Phone field entry

## Knowledge used
docs/renderer/contract.md

## Assumptions
Label text comes from a Custom Label.

## Cross-repo dependencies
None

## Risks and reviewer focus
Field-level security handling in the renderer.

## Not done
Nothing.
